svg.title: Specification: the tools in use
svg.desc: Movement specification, the tech stack in eight registers: languages: TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Java, PHP, SQL, C, HTML & CSS; interfaces: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, Tailwind CSS; services: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Django, FastAPI, Flask, Laravel; data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite; intelligence: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Pandas, NumPy, LangChain, Hugging Face, AWS Bedrock; cloud: AWS · Lambda, SQS, CDK, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud; delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions; observatory: Prometheus, Grafana, Nginx, Git, Jupyter, Streamlit.
